title: Choice and option selection
summary: This topic loosely groups comments about being able to choose settings, features, destinations, or even the car itself, with many fragments too ambiguous or unrelated to support a single clear theme.

negative.summary: The only clearly negative comment says the lack of manual transmission choice made the owner uncomfortable.

undetermined.summary: Most fragments mention choosing, numbers, kids, apps, or showroom remarks without enough context to determine a clear sentiment for this topic.

limitations: This cluster mixes loosely related and unrelated subjects, including transmission preference, navigation choices, app lists, child preference, brand choice, and showroom praise.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so there is limited evidence for a coherent sentiment pattern beyond the single negative example.
Samples are sentiment-stratified and not representative estimates of all reviews on this topic.
